_comment: LAYER 1 — fact sheet for a FICTIONAL demo garage, 'Prime Auto Garage & Rentals'. This is not a real business; names, staff and the registration number are invented so the demo has something concrete to book against, same convention as data/canopy.json, data/clinic.json and data/salon.json. Service/rental pricing lives in garage_commercial.json (Layer 2), also dummy.
garage_type: multi-brand car service center + self-drive/chauffeur car rentals
tagline: Your car, our care — service and rentals under one roof
registration_number: PUNE-GARAGE-REG-2027-00512 (DEMO PLACEHOLDER — not a real registration)

rental_terms.documents_required: A valid driving license and one government photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport) — verified AT PICKUP, never collected or noted down over a phone call.
rental_terms.security_deposit: A refundable security deposit is required, amount varies by car category — the team confirms the exact figure at booking.
rental_terms.fuel_policy: Same-to-same — return the car with the same fuel level as at pickup.
rental_terms.self_drive_or_chauffeur: Both self-drive and with-chauffeur options are available.
rental_terms.minimum_age: Minimum 21 years old with at least 1 year of driving experience, for self-drive rentals.

timings.rental_pickup_drop: Mon-Sat, 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM (outside these hours needs prior arrangement)

roadside_note: This garage does not run a 24x7 roadside/towing dispatch. A caller describing an ONGOING breakdown or accident on the road right now should be told to contact a roadside assistance/towing service or their insurer's helpline immediately — never offered a routine service slot for an active roadside emergency.
estimate_note: Any repair cost quoted over the phone is a ROUGH estimate only. The exact cost is confirmed after the technician physically inspects the vehicle — never promise a final bill over the phone.
media_caveat: Photos of the workshop and rental fleet online are illustrative; the exact vehicle assigned may vary by availability on the day.
legal_caveat: This garage does not provide a binding repair quote or rental confirmation over the phone. Exact service cost is confirmed after inspection; exact rental availability and final terms are confirmed by the team before pickup. Prices here are indicative only.
